scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the live NGC 6992 remote-pier imaging run during the reserved clear-sky hour.
Emerging Need: The run moves from scheduled setup into a metered capture attempt, then the same sequencer stops at a rotator safety check and cannot resume unaided.
Decision Context: The console will not accept setup values before a live run exists, and only saved camera-train notes distinguish the correct adapter offset from a similar DSLR value.
Consequence: Without timely access to the usable offset and orientation, the paused run is abandoned and the remaining target window is lost.

parameter.title: Remote Pier NGC 6992 imaging run
parameter.description: Reserved member imaging time for the Eastern Veil Nebula using Miriam's ZWO camera train; run settings load after the remote console opens.

parameter.subject: Tonight's remote-pier slot is weather-go
parameter.body: The 21:00 NGC 6992 member slot remains weather-go. Console access opens at 20:55. Rotator overrides are ignored until a live run ID exists, and staff will not pre-enter adapter offsets before the sequence starts.

parameter.description: Metered credit authorization opened for Miriam's live NGC 6992 remote-pier run RP-8721 when the first slew began.

parameter.subject: Run RP-8721 has started capturing
parameter.body: Run RP-8721 loaded the NGC 6992 plan, completed autofocus, and saved two guide-check subframes. The sequencer is continuing under the metered slot unless a safety stop appears.

parameter.content: RP-8721 took two subs, then the sequencer stopped at the rotator safety check. The console cannot resume until the ZWO-camera adapter offset and cable-down or cable-up orientation are entered. The paused run stays editable until 21:38; values can go through this chat or the console note.

parameter.subject: Run RP-8721 abandoned after rotator hold expired
parameter.body: The rotator safety hold for RP-8721 expired at 21:38 with no accepted adapter value. The target has dropped behind the pier house limit, so the remaining NGC 6992 queued subframes are not recoverable tonight.
